# KumikoUI — Unit Testing

## Test projects

| Project | Tests | Runs on |
|---|---|---|
| `tests/KumikoUI.Core.Tests` | Core: models, `KumikoSource`, layout, input, editing, drawn components, `KumikoRenderer` through recording contexts, allocation and timing budgets | any OS, `net10.0`; also references `KumikoUI.SkiaSharp` for the font and glyph tests |
| `tests/KumikoUI.SkiaSharp.Tests` | `SkiaDrawingContext` and its caches on a real `SKSurface`: golden images, emoji shaping, allocation, text consistency | any OS (`SkiaSharp.NativeAssets.Linux` on Linux) |
| `tests/KumikoUI.SourceGenerators.Tests` | The `[KumikoGridItem]` generator, with Roslyn | any OS |
| `tests/KumikoUI.Maui.Tests` | The platform-independent MAUI host logic and a control created without a handler (frame scheduler, text-input mappers, `MauiImageLoader`) | any OS, `net10.0` |
| `tests/KumikoUI.Uno.Tests` | The platform-independent Uno host logic (`Uno.Sdk`, `net10.0-desktop`): input mapping, gestures, text-input adapter, frame scheduler, image loader | any OS |
| `tests/KumikoUI.Docs.Snippets.Maui` / `.Uno` | Not tests: compiled README and package-README snippets, generated by `eng/DocsSnippets` | Mac Catalyst / desktop head |

Nothing in these projects drives a device: on-device checks are `eng/devflow` (MAUI, see its README) and the sample apps.

## Rules

- Framework: **xUnit** (`[Fact]` and `[Theory]` + `[InlineData]`). Never NUnit or MSTest. `Xunit` is a global using.
- One test class per source class or per behavior: `KumikoRectTests` for `KumikoRect`, `KumikoSourceGroupingTests` for
  grouping. File name `{ClassName}Tests.cs`, in the folder that mirrors the source (`Input/`, `Editing/`, `Rendering/`, `Components/`, `Data/`).
- Core tests see Core's `internal` members (`InternalsVisibleTo`); do not make a member public to test it.
- Core logic is tested in Core, never through a host. A host test covers only what the host adds.
- Run one project: `dotnet test tests/KumikoUI.Core.Tests -c Release`. Filter to one class:
  `dotnet test tests/KumikoUI.Core.Tests -c Release --filter "FullyQualifiedName~KumikoSourceGroupingTests"`.
- **Timing tests** carry `[Trait("Category", "Performance")]`. CI's coverage run skips them
  (`--filter "Category!=Performance"`) because instrumentation slows them; the uninstrumented Core test matrix runs them. On a busy machine, rerun one alone before
  believing a failure.
- **Allocation tests** (`RenderAllocationTests` in Core, `SkiaAllocationTests` in SkiaSharp) assert 0 managed bytes per
  steady-state frame. A change to the render loop that allocates fails them.
- A known defect is pinned as `[Fact(Skip = "Known defect: ...")]`; the fix removes the `Skip`.
- Golden images (`tests/KumikoUI.SkiaSharp.Tests/Goldens`): `GoldenImage` compares block averages, not exact pixels. Set
  `KUMIKO_UPDATE_GOLDENS=1` to rewrite them after an intended visual change, and review the diff images.
- Test names read `{Member}_{Scenario}_{Expected}`.

---

## `[Fact]` — single scenario

```csharp
[Fact]
public void {MethodName}_{Scenario}_Returns{Expected}()
{
    // Arrange
    var sut = new {ClassName}();

    // Act
    var result = sut.{MethodName}(args);

    // Assert
    Assert.Equal(expected, result);
}
```

## `[Theory]` — data-driven

```csharp
[Theory]
[InlineData(/* input */, /* expected */)]
[InlineData(/* input */, /* expected */)]
public void {MethodName}_{Scenario}({Type} input, {Type} expected)
{
    var sut = new {ClassName}();
    Assert.Equal(expected, sut.{MethodName}(input));
}
```

## Example: `KumikoSource` sorting

The real sorting API is `SetColumns`, `SetItems`, `SetSort`, `ToggleSort`, `ClearSort`; read rows back with `GetItem` or
`GetCellDisplayText`. A nested item type keeps the test self-contained.

```csharp
public class KumikoSourceSortingExampleTests
{
    private sealed class Item
    {
        public string Name { get; set; } = "";
    }

    private static KumikoSource MakeSource(KumikoColumn column, params Item[] items)
    {
        var source = new KumikoSource();
        source.SetColumns(new[] { column });
        source.SetItems(items.ToList());
        return source;
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SetSort_Ascending_OrdersRowsCorrectly()
    {
        var column = new KumikoColumn { PropertyName = "Name", ColumnType = KumikoColumnType.Text };
        var source = MakeSource(column,
            new Item { Name = "Charlie" }, new Item { Name = "Alice" }, new Item { Name = "Bob" });

        source.SetSort(column, KumikoSortDirection.Ascending);

        Assert.Equal("Alice", source.GetCellDisplayText(0, column));
        Assert.Equal("Bob", source.GetCellDisplayText(1, column));
        Assert.Equal("Charlie", source.GetCellDisplayText(2, column));
    }
}
```

A source with 10,000 or more items rebuilds sorting on a worker only when it has a `SynchronizationContext` and its
`BackgroundRebuildThreshold` is set; a test that needs the rebuilt view awaits `source.WhenViewUpdatedAsync()`
(`BackgroundRebuildTests` shows how).

## Test doubles for rendering

Rendering tests run against `IDrawingContext` doubles in `tests/KumikoUI.Core.Tests/TestHelpers/`:

| Helper | Use |
|---|---|
| `RecordingDrawingContext` | Records every `IDrawingContext` call as a `DrawOp`, in call order (index = z-order), in viewport coordinates with the active clip; measures text monospace (8 px per character, 14 px tall). `DrawOp.Visible` is the part of an op its clip lets reach the screen. `Texts`, `Fills`, `Lines`, `SingleText(text)` filter the ops. |
| `NoOpDrawingContext` | Draws and records nothing and allocates nothing, so a test measures what the managed render loop itself allocates. |
| `RenderHarness` | A grid of people wired to a `KumikoRenderer`, with every `KumikoColor` of its style given a distinct value (so a recorded color identifies its style role). `RenderHarness.Create(...)`, then `h.Render()`. |
| `CellRendererExtensions` | `renderer.Render(ctx, cellRect, value, ...)` for a cell renderer test without building a `CellRenderContext`. |
| `InputGrid` (`Input/`) | A grid and `KumikoInputController` for pointer and keyboard tests. |
| `ComponentInput` (`Components/`) | Pointer and key events for a drawn component. |

```csharp
var h = RenderHarness.Create(width: 300);
h.Column("Name").FreezeMode = ColumnFreezeMode.Left;
h.Scroll.OffsetX = 50;

var ctx = h.Render();

var cell = ctx.SingleText("P00");
Assert.Equal(new KumikoRect(0, 0, 150, 400), cell.Clip);
```

A new `IDrawingContext` member must be added to `NoOpDrawingContext` and `RecordingDrawingContext` too.

## Documentation checks

`.github/instructions`, `.github/prompts`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/RENDERING.md` and `docs/uno/README.md` are checked by
`dotnet run --project eng/DocsIdentifiers -c Release`: every backticked identifier and file name in them must exist in the code.
Run it after renaming or removing a type or member; a name that is not code goes in `eng/DocsIdentifiers/allowlist.txt` with a reason.
